Sam: quick sweep found a 403 on an image and a dead gist link in /kb/runtime/error-handling.md — no owner listed.

Alina: can you paste the exact lines? I can do a small PR.

Sam: lines:
![error trace](https://legacy-assets.redwood/diag/error-stack.png)
see snippet: https://gist.github.com/badlink/12345
curl -> HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden

docs-bot: scanner: orphan-image detected in /kb/runtime/error-handling.md; no CODEOWNERS matched.

Alina: I'll rehost to /assets/docs/runtime/error-stack.png, migrate the gist into snippets/runtime/error-trace.md and include with `{{< include-snippet "runtime/error-trace" >}}`. Will add `alt` text and a short caption. ETA: today EOD.

infra-bot: reminder: new asset paths may be blocked by the bucket allowlist in CI. If docs CI fails with a 403 on upload, tag @infra in the PR for a one-off allowlist.

Sam: thanks — please post the PR link here when ready and I'll review.
